title: Grimoire Manifest
description: A grimoire manifest declares which spells (with optional version constraints) a project or machine wants in scope. Lives at `<project>/.grimoire.toml` or `~/.config/grimoire/manifest.toml`. Mirrors `Manifest` in src/manifest.rs.

spells.description: Top-level set of spells the manifest wants present. Use a profile if you need multiple selectable sets.

overrides.description: Per-spell overrides keyed by spell name. Currently supports only `channel`.

profiles.description: Named alternate spell sets. Selected with `grimoire cast --profile <name>`.

channel.description: Channel key to use for this spell. Must exist on the spell.
